The ruins could well be a remnant of the ancient civilization of the [[Forgotten]], possibly centered at the spot where the [[Lair of the Forgotten]] now stands. ==Getting there== While doing the quest [[Horde of Darkness]], players will most likely enter from [[Joko's Domain]] to the south. [[Lair of the Forgotten]] (towards the north) provides the most convenient outpost for future travel to this area. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Ghostly Priest]] → It may be a good idea to bring three [[Signet of Capture|Signets of Capture]] and get them all. Take note to put those signets in skill slots that do not prevent the most important Junundu skills. *These quests affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: **[[Destroy the Ungrateful Slaves]] **[[Getting Even]] **[[Horde of Darkness]] **[[Refuse the King]] **[[Wayward Guide]] *{{Vanquisher|count = 310|low = 278|high = 341}} **With quests you can reach just over 400 foes. **With the exception of the rocky areas to the northwest and southeast, most of the area can be vanquished while inside a Junundu. **Watch out for [[Popup|hidden]] [[insect]] groups in the eastern portions and be careful of getting swarmed by two or more groups. **Active quests in this area increases the number of Margonite groups. {{Explorable areas in the Desolation}} [[Category:Has Lightbringer bounties]] [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Die Zerklüfteten Schluchten]]
